title: AI Agent 跨平台終於有共同標準了：Agent Plugins 統一封裝，安全與信任仍留白
excerpt: On August 6, 2026, OpenAI and rivals Amazon, Microsoft, Cursor, and Vercel jointly published the open standard Agent Plugins 1.0; Google subsequently joined as a core maintainer. The standard packages MCP servers and Agent Skills into a single portable format using a plugin.json file. The 1.0 spec deliberately limits itself to packaging and discovery, leaving marketplaces, installation, permissions, sandboxing, and trust to each platform. Developer reactions are split: some celebrate the 'build once, run anywhere' promise, while others call it a thin standard whose useful parts will end up client-specific.
